The conditional entry now composes bound finite requests and constructs exact
operator/reference equality from their explicit leaf equations. Before that
path can support inverse/control access, propagate actual leaf unitarity as
well. Strengthen the mathematical leaf premise to require a common decoded
operator with complete `UnitaryInterface` at the bound physical endpoint.

Prove unitarity by induction over actual conditional derivations, using the
existing whole-space operator/typing laws. For ordinary rules extract actual
child premises; for the controlled-power schema use its actual repeat/control
nodes and provider proof. Do not assume every node in an arbitrary global

returned by the real checker; zero repetitions still retain it.

Construct a common unitary entry denotation and derive both inverse laws and
